explanation: The statement is about the library's own notion of the coefficient span of a right comodule (`RightComodule.coefficient`, `RightComodule.coefficientSpan`, `RightComoduleHom`) and the pull-back lemma `coefficient_apply`. Mathlib has no theory of comodules over a coalgebra at all: `Coalgebra` exists (RingTheory/Coalgebra/Basic.lean) but grepping Mathlib for `coaction`, `comodule`, `RightComodule`, and `coefficientSpan`/`Coefficient` in the coalgebra files returns nothing relevant. Mathlib's contributions here are only generic facts (`Submodule.span_le`, `Submodule.subset_span`, `LinearMap.rTensor_comp`), which do not carry the mathematical content of the statement. Hence no duplicate or single-declaration special case exists.
